mon.title: Wake up and get light
mon.note: Up at the first alarm. Drink water, wash your face, step outside for 5 to 10 minutes.

mon.title: Morning devotion
mon.note: Read one chapter, pray (thanks, confession, requests), and write one line in the journal.

mon.title: Breakfast and get ready
mon.note: Breakfast: Overnight oats. Get dressed and grab your packed lunch.

mon.title: Drive to the store
mon.note: 6 minutes. Phone away.

mon.title: Store: opening prep
mon.note: Get the store ready to open at 8:30 and handle anything urgent.

mon.title: Ledger: deep work
mon.note: The hardest Ledger task, the one you wrote down yesterday. Stand up for 2 minutes at 9:45. Only real store needs interrupt.

mon.title: Movement break
mon.note: Desk reset: back bends, hip-flexor stretch, chest stretch, 10 squats, shoulder rolls. Then walk the store.

mon.title: Dad's website
mon.note: One focused block on the website.

mon.title: Lunch
mon.note: Lunch: Chicken wrap: tortilla, chicken, spinach, cheese, salsa or hummus. Eat away from the screen.

mon.title: Lunch walk
mon.note: 15 minutes outside.

mon.title: Ledger: deep work, part 2
mon.note: Keep going on the same task, no switching. Stand up at 2:30.

mon.title: Back-care break
mon.note: Cat-cow, child's pose, glute bridges, bird dog, dead bug, figure-4 stretch. Then water.

mon.title: Store floor
mon.note: Stocking, customers, and the list of things that waited.

mon.title: Store: admin and close-out
mon.note: Email, orders, end of day. Write down tomorrow's first Ledger task before you go.

mon.title: Head home
mon.note: 6-minute drive, then wash up for dinner.

mon.title: Dinner with family
mon.note: Phone away at the table.

mon.title: Family time
mon.note: Talk, help at home, or take a family walk.

mon.title: Guitar app
mon.note: Improve your guitar app (through Nov 15, then this becomes Door Project time).

mon.title: Dad's website
mon.note: One focused block on the website. A Ledger block the store took over comes first.

mon.title: Free time
mon.note: Your 30 minutes for whatever you like.

mon.title: Guitar practice
mon.note: Practice in your guitar app: 5 min warm-up, 15 min on the current song or chords, 10 min playing for fun.

mon.title: Evening devotion
mon.note: A Psalm, the Proverbs chapter for today's date, and prayer over the day.

mon.title: Shower and bed
mon.note: Shower, lay out tomorrow's clothes, phone on the charger across the room.

mon.title: Sleep
mon.note: Lights out.
